::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 5. 1865  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS. 55384 (1): P.440
:::

My dear Miss Yonge	
The photograph is from a picture by [Mr Farren](people/person_500.qmd) the young artist whom [I](people/person_939.qmd) wanted to [illustrate](organizations/other_167.qmd) your [Bethlehem](organizations/other_177.qmd). I was anxious to know that you thought him up to the mark. The picture was from Kingsleys [Saints Tragedy](other_books/otherbook_398.qmd), Saint Elizabeth of Hungary carrying her child to the altar in the early morning. I think it indicates a power considerably above average of entering into a spiritual conception. But I should be glad of your opinion.

I am having all you sent of the Bethlehem set up. I would like to go over it altogether, and when I do I want to write you about it. I think there are two or three points which might [be] worth considering  again. But I will try to write at some length when I have the three chapters in type.

I am glad you find the [Shipwreck Volms](other_books/otherbook_384.qmd) interesting.

I enclose a [cheque](organizations/other_160.qmd) for the month. I think as far as I can guess that the story is liked.

Yours ever very truly
A. Macmillan
